description: Labor CRUD over three tables: worker (the rate book), time_entry (clock-in/out), worker_legal (masked PII docs). op picks the verb, entity the table. delete also removes files the row references.

op.description: get (404 if absent) | put (create/replace) | update (patch via updates) | query (one partition) | delete (the row and its uploads; irreversible).

entity.description: worker: rate book, keys contact_id + role. time_entry: clock event, keys worker_id + entry_id. worker_legal: legal doc row, keys worker_id + sk; SSN-masked JSON only.

contact_id.description: worker hash key (the contact paid); required for worker.

role.description: worker range key; required for worker.

worker_id.description: time_entry / worker_legal hash key; required there.

entry_id.description: time_entry range key; generated on put, required on get/update/delete.

sk.description: worker_legal range key, role#type e.g. barista#W-4; required there.

attributes.description: put: the entity's non-key fields (top level also works), validated against labor_fields. worker: rate, classification (W-2|1099). time_entry: role, started_at, ended_at (ms-epoch or ISO 8601), status (open|closed). worker_legal: type (W-4, I-9, DE-4, PASSPORT…), value (masked JSON).

job.description: put: job tag on a time entry; the accrual carries dimensions.job.

task_id.description: put: task on a time entry; the accrual carries dimensions.task. Log fix work against the class task (ISSUE#<hash>).

updates.description: update, required: non-key changes; keys and created_at immutable. worker: rate, classification. time_entry: ended_at, status (closed + ended_at clocks out, then the accrual runs). worker_legal: type, value.

fields.description: query: only these attributes per row; keys always included.
